description: Fetch one organisation page (a participation: organisation details plus its representatives). Use list_organisations to find participation ids; use get_participant for a single person. Resolves the menu path automatically; pass path to override.

event.description: B2match event URL, slug/euid, or numeric event id.

participation_id.description: Participation id from list_organisations or my_participation.

path.description: Optional event menu path (e.g. /components/<id>) from get_event navigation; omit to resolve it automatically.

name: get_organisation
title: Get B2match organisation
